verdict.rationale: Project-local scope is well evidenced: skills live at `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` inside the project, and a hands-on probe installed a skill into `./.claude/skills/` in a scratch project dir, making it committable with the repo. User-global scope is only implied, by plugin docs describing plugins as "reusable across projects" and "shared across projects and teams"; no user-level skills directory or scope-selection flag is documented. missing for 10: documented user-global skills location (e.g. home-directory skills folder), explicit install-scope choice at install time, independent corroboration of global installs.
